label: Trailer Cinematográfico (60s) · Reino de Cinzas (Dark Fantasy Épico)
description: Trailer de fantasia sombria medieval em 16:9: castelos em ruínas sob céu tempestuoso, exércitos com armaduras de ferro forjado e tochas, dragões ancestrais e coroas quebradas sob a neve.
resources: sound design de ferro, fogo e percussão

scenes.prompt: Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Extreme wide shot of a colossal ruined gothic fortress perched on a jagged obsidian mountain ridge under a stormy crimson sky. Lightning illuminates ancient stone spires. 35mm film texture, heavy atmospheric fog. Non-verbal sound design: distant thunder rumble and deep resonant war horn echo. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: OS REINOS CAÍRAM.

Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Macro shot of an ancient damaged steel broadsword planted in frozen snow-covered mud. Embers and ashes drift slowly past the blade as blood-red firelight flickers on the cold iron. Non-verbal sound design: wind howling through mountain passes, metallic ring of cold steel. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: UMA COROA FORJADA NO FOGO.

Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Low-angle tracking shot through a vast army of thousands of armored warriors holding flaming torches in the pitch-black night. Helmets and shields glisten under rain and torchlight. Non-verbal sound design: heavy synchronized shield-banging rhythm and guttural war chants. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A GUERRA FINAL.

Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Massive shadow sweeps over the battlefield as a gargantuan winged ancestral dragon descends through boiling storm clouds, breathing a catastrophic stream of golden fire that illuminates the valley. Non-verbal sound design: deafening draconic roar and massive low-end fire explosion. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O DESPERTAR DAS CINZAS.

Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Fast-paced battle montage: clash of heavy broadswords with flying sparks, cavalry charge through snowy forests, magical glyphs igniting in stone circles. Non-verbal sound design: relentless war drums, clashing armor, cinematic braams. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: QUEM HERDARÁ O TRONO?

Epic dark fantasy blockbuster trailer cinematography in 16:9. Hero title reveal: heavy weathered stone and forged iron 3D typography carved with ancient glowing runes, surrounded by falling snow and rising embers. Grand slow zoom. Non-verbal sound design: massive orchestral crescendo resolving into a lone chilling choir chord. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: REINO DE CINZAS.

narration.text: Quando os antigos reis caíram, o mundo acreditou que a paz havia chegado. Mas a escuridão não morre. Ela apenas espera que você esqueça o valor do fogo.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira madura, grave, profunda, épica, rouca e majestosa, tom de lorde medieval guerreiro

blocks.text: Quando os antigos tronos ruíram, o mundo celebrou.
Mas a escuridão nunca foi derrotada.
Ela apenas aguardava o momento certo para retornar.
Agora, o fogo ancestral despertou novamente.
Apenas um herdeiro sobreviverá ao inverno.
Reino de Cinzas. Uma nova era se inicia.

audio.musicIntent: Epic dark Nordic fantasy orchestral score with massive war drums, cellos, chanting male choir, heavy brass horns and a thunderous cinematic climax.
